verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect, programmatic access to contact data: the MCP server can read and write contacts (and manage mailing lists), the CLI can manage contacts, and contacts are viewable on the Audience page. None of this is documented as a bulk, self-serve export in an open format. Missing for 10: a documented one-click or bulk export (e.g., CSV) of the full audience; evidence that custom fields and tags are included; export of engagement history; export of the suppression/unsubscribe list; independent or hands-on confirmation that an export works.
